definitions.explanation: The act of increasing or improving something, especially health, welfare, understanding, or relations. Implies a positive, deliberate effort to make something better or stronger.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}に{努|つと}める。
examples.english: To work toward improving one's health.

examples.japanese: {食欲|しょくよく}を{増進|ぞうしん}させる{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: It has the effect of stimulating appetite.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{友好|ゆうこう}{関係|かんけい}の{増進|ぞうしん}を{目指|めざ}して{会談|かいだん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Talks were held with the aim of enhancing friendly relations between the two countries.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly paired with {健康|けんこう} (health) in the compound {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん} (health promotion). Also frequently used with abstract concepts like {理解|りかい} (understanding), {友好|ゆうこう} (friendship), and {福祉|ふくし} (welfare). A formal word used in official and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}: health promotion
- {食欲|しょくよく}{増進|ぞうしん}: appetite stimulation
- {増進|ぞうしん}を{図|はか}る: to seek to promote/enhance
- {増進|ぞうしん}に{努|つと}める: to strive to improve
